verifications.note: p.80, 'Nautilus Pipeline': 'Length: 115 miles (185 km) — 96 miles (154 km) offshore, 19 miles (31 km) onshore' — exact match to the recorded LengthKnown=154.00 km as the pipeline's offshore segment.

FERC Docket CP96-790-000 (filed 1996-09-16): Nautilus's original certificate application sought authority to 'construct and operate approximately 101 miles of 30-inch diameter pipeline' from a Ship Shoal platform to the Garden City plant — the as-certificated design length (~162.5 km), ~8.5 km longer than the current 96-mile/154 km offshore figure. Corroborating context on the pipeline's length, not an exact match to 154 km; restated verbatim in the 1997-08-05 compliance-filing notice already on this row (FR-1997-08-05/97-20525).

resolutions.researcher_notes: Enbridge's own July-2020 factsheet gives an EXACT match to the recorded 154.00 km: the Nautilus system totals 115 mi/185 km, split 96 mi/154 km offshore + 19 mi/31 km onshore — GEM's LengthKnown tracks the offshore segment only. The two 1996/1997 FERC certificate notices (already on this row for Construction/Status) instead describe the ORIGINAL certificated design as 'approximately 101 miles,' and a third already-opened source (the 1996 OGJ article on the pre-FERC project proposal) cites yet another figure, 87 miles, for the same offshore line at the earlier planning stage. Read together these three figures (87 mi proposed → 101 mi certificated → 96 mi offshore as currently operated) track the project's evolution across stages rather than disagreeing about one fixed measurement, so they are not treated as contradicting the recorded 154 km — flagging only as a validity/spec note that the certificated (101 mi) vs. as-operated (96 mi offshore) gap could reflect an actual route change worth a closer look someday, not evidence the current 154 km figure is wrong. Did not add the OGJ 87-mile figure or the 1997-08-05 restatement as separate proposed_refs since both are duplicative of the two already listed.

verifications.note: p.80: 'Enbridge has a 74.33% ownership interest in the Nautilus Pipeline.' Directly CONTRADICTS the sheet's recorded Owner1=Enbridge 100.00%.

Genesis Energy, L.P. Form 8-K Exhibit 99.4 (filed 2015-07-16, combined financials of the Offshore Gulf of Mexico business acquired from Enterprise Products Operating LLC): 'Neptune Pipeline Company, LLC ... owns a 100% member interest in ... Nautilus Pipeline Company, LLC ... Neptune is owned 74.33% by Enbridge Offshore Gas Transmission and 25.67% by Sailfish Pipeline Company, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of EPO.' Confirms the 74.33/25.67 split via the Neptune holding company and dates the 25.67% stake's transfer into what became Genesis Energy's book.

Genesis Energy, L.P. underwriting agreement for its $750M 6.750% Senior Notes due 2034 (Exhibit 1.1, dated 2026-02-18): lists Genesis's subsidiary as directly/indirectly owning '25.67% of the equity interests in Neptune (which as of the date of this Agreement owns 100% of the equity interests in each of Nautilus and Manta Ray Offshore ...)'. Confirms the 25.67% Neptune/Nautilus stake is CURRENT as of Feb 2026, not a stale pre-2015 fact.

resolutions.researcher_notes: CONTRADICTS THE SHEET. Recorded Owner1=Enbridge 100.00% is not supported by any source found; every independent primary source located instead describes a two-tier structure: Nautilus Pipeline Company, L.L.C. is 100%-owned by Neptune Pipeline Company, L.L.C., and Neptune itself is held 74.33% by Enbridge (via 'Enbridge Offshore Gas Transmission') and 25.67% by Sailfish Pipeline Company, LLC — a subsidiary of Genesis Energy, L.P. since Genesis's 2015 acquisition of Enterprise Products' Gulf of Mexico offshore business (the 8-K Ex-99.4 discloses the acquired financials; the Feb-2026 underwriting-agreement exhibit confirms Genesis's subsidiary still holds that 25.67% stake today). The 25.67% minority share traces back to the pipeline's original 1997 FERC ownership disclosure on this row's FR-1997-08-05 notice (Sailfish Pipeline Co., then a subsidiary of Leviathan Gas Pipeline Partners, L.P., holding 25.67%) — that share size has been stable for ~29 years while the majority interest (originally Marathon Gas Transmission 24.33% + Shell Seahorse Company 50.00% per the same 1997 notice) consolidated over time into Enbridge's current 74.33%. Recommend Owner1=Enbridge 74.33%, Owner2=Genesis Energy, L.P. (or the operating subsidiary 'Sailfish Pipeline Company, LLC') 25.67% — flagging for Update/validity routing per this pass's brief; not applying the value change here, only sourcing what the refs actually state.
